command:
set -eu
echo LOGGER_METADATA_BEGIN
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
echo MATCHED_MODULES
cat /proc/modules | awk '$1 ~ /qdf_tcon|tztv_frc_tcon|sdp/ {print}'
echo LOG_CONTROLS
for p in /sys/kernel/debug/dynamic_debug/control /proc/dynamic_debug/control /dev/kmsg /sys/module/qdf_tcon/parameters /sys/module/tztv_frc_tcon_api/parameters /sys/module/tztv_frc_tcon/parameters; do
if test -e "$p"; then stat -c '%F %a %n' "$p"; if test -d "$p"; then for q in "$p"/*; do test -e "$q" || continue; stat -c '%F %a %n' "$q"; done; fi; else echo "ABSENT $p"; fi
done
echo TRACE_EVENTS
for p in /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/events/*; do test -d "$p" || continue; echo "${p##*/}"; done
echo LOGGER_METADATA_END
